name: window-management-plus
title: Window Management+
description: Companion to Raycast's Window Management: tile every open window at once, with sidebar, rotate and swap. Requires Raycast Pro.
author: connorforsyth

preferences.name: sidebar
preferences.title: Sidebar
preferences.description: Window pinned full height down the right by Auto Tile with Sidebar.

commands.name: auto-tile
commands.title: Auto Tile
commands.description: Arrange every visible window in two even rows.

commands.name: auto-tile-sidebar
commands.title: Auto Tile with Sidebar
commands.description: Pin the sidebar app (Raycast Notes by default) full height down the right and tile every other visible window in two rows.

commands.name: tile-largest-left
commands.title: Tile Largest Window Left
commands.description: Largest window fills the left. The rest stack in a column on the right.

commands.name: tile-largest-right
commands.title: Tile Largest Window Right
commands.description: Largest window fills the right. The rest stack in a column on the left.

commands.name: rotate
commands.title: Rotate Windows
commands.description: Move each window into the next window's position.

commands.name: rotate-backwards
commands.title: Rotate Windows Backwards
commands.description: Move each window into the previous window's position.

commands.name: swap-with-largest
commands.title: Swap Active Window with Largest
commands.description: Trade places between the active window and the largest one.

commands.name: toggle-menu-bar-visibility
commands.title: Toggle Menu Bar Visibility
commands.description: Hide or show the menu bar.
